conventions.qpos: 17 values: base xyz metres; base quaternion wxyz; left yaw roll pitch knee ankle; right yaw roll pitch knee ankle radians
conventions.trajectory: 181 kinematic configurations, knee -0.00494 to pi/2, symmetric zero yaw/roll; ankle=knee-hip_pitch; solve left foot site x=0 with root upright/base x=y=0; set root z so lower of both sole meshes touches z=0; both sole site orientations identity
conventions.timing: phase 0..1 only; no speed, torque, contact-force, stability, or dynamic feasibility claim. qpos file generic qpos key is feet-flat crouch trajectory.
conventions.stock_grounded: Change root z only until lowest sole vertex touches ground; this does not fix foot pitch or other penetrations.

scope: All original visual meshes convex hulls. Ignore only same-body/direct parent-child assembled interfaces. Hull overlaps are conservative flags; CAD may be concave and intended interfaces may remain. Ground vertex min is direct mesh geometry.
